title: How the population changed where you live: Census 2021
meta_description: Discover how the population has changed in your area based on Census 2021 data, including changes to age and rounded population density and totals.

breadcrumb.text: How the population changed where you live: Census 2021

lede: Using the first results from Census 2021, we look at which local authority areas have seen the biggest population increases and decreases, which areas had the largest growth in different age groups, and how your chosen area compares with others.
